2608.22617.title: AI-based worker guidance in assembly and disassembly operations using multimodal ego/exo-centric data capture and structured task knowledge
2608.22617.paper_summary: Assembly and disassembly processes rely on expert knowledge that is difficult to document, reuse, and transfer. This paper presents a data-centric approach for extracting structured task knowledge from expert demonstrations using egocentric and exocentric recordings. Temporal and multimodal information from video and narration is jointly encoded to derive structured task representations that enable procedural documentation and context-aware worker guidance. The approach is evaluated on a real-world disassembly case study, demonstrating that video-based representations capture procedural structure and execution context beyond static image-based methods. The results highlight the potential of egocentric video understanding for repair, training, and circular manufacturing applications. Project website: https://indego-assistant.github.io/
2608.22617.paper_summary_zh: 組裝和拆卸過程依賴於難以記錄、重用和轉移的專業知識。本文提出了一種以數據為中心的方法，通過使用自我中心和外部中心的錄音，從專家示範中提取結構化的任務知識。來自視頻和旁白的時間和多模態信息被共同編碼，以推導出結構化的任務表示，這使得程序文檔和上下文感知的工作指導成為可能。該方法在一個真實世界的拆卸案例研究中進行評估，證明基於視頻的表示能夠捕捉程序結構和執行上下文，超越靜態圖像基礎的方法。結果突顯了自我中心視頻理解在維修、培訓和循環製造應用中的潛力。項目網站：https://indego-assistant.github.io/
